ModMetaData.name: Dawn of a New Day
ModMetaData.author: AlenDio
ModMetaData.description: Adds a customizable header overlay that displays at the start of the day. Settings Go to: Options > Mod options > "Dawn of a New Day" Mod Compatibility - Modern Notifications: Added formats and texts for Reminders and Occasions. Latest Patch # v2.0.0 - Joined Text, Label Format and Separator into one Overlay Widget Section. - Added a preview of the overlay in the settings. - Added a way to recover legacy format and backups. - Fixed custom fonts for RimWorld 1.7. - Fixed possible NullReferenceException(s) for formats. - Added 'if' rich text tag (see in the mod). - Added comparation operations for formats and values (useful for 'if' tag). - Added Silent Format Error (if enabled, when a token format has error will just return an empty string, instead of showing the token). - Added 12-hour meridiem format token. Can be safely added or removed from existing saves at any time.
